desc: If you're looking for a rifle that works hard and plays harder built by one of the most trusted names in firearms then you're looking for the Mossberg Patriot. Mossberg continues to add unprecedented value to their affordable Patriot line-up with the addition of a hard hitting .350 Legend that is purpose built for hunting with a hard hitting straight walled cartridge. The Mossberg Patriot .350 Legend is an excellent choice for putting meat on the table year after year. This is a versatile and accurate rifle that gives you uncanny constancy with every round that you send down range. It features a durable all-weather synthetic stock and a tough matte blued finish to protect your investment. The precision machined 22" barrel offers superb accuracy with a button rifled 1:16 twist rate and a target crown. An LBA adjustable trigger allows you to fine tune this rifle to your shooting style and a detachable box mag adds convenience. Solidly built and lightweight, this rifle will certainly impress new and seasoned shooters alike. Fill your freezer in style, hunting season after hunting season, with the Mossberg Patriot.
